# Allegro Digital

Allegro Digital is a web design and local SEO agency in Port Elizabeth (Gqeberha), South Africa. We build high-converting websites for South African small businesses, with transparent pricing and a focus on local search visibility.

## Who we help
- Small businesses in Port Elizabeth / Gqeberha and the Eastern Cape
- Guest houses and B&Bs
- Trades (plumbers, electricians, contractors)
- Medical and dental practices
- Law firms and accounting practices
- Restaurants
- Online stores

## What we do
- Website design and build (5-page business sites, e-commerce, service practice sites)
- Local SEO (Google Business Profile, reviews, citations, local content)
- Hosting, care and support (monthly)
- Add-ons: SEO, social media, logo work

## Pricing (published, as of 2026)
- Website build: R1,499 once-off (focused build) up to R16,900+ for larger scopes
- Hosting + care + support: R800/month
- SEO add-on: R1,999/month (on top of an existing website)
- Typical small business site: R5,000 - R9,000 once-off plus R300 - R800/month
- See /pricing.md for the full machine-readable breakdown
